purpose: Teach: 鳴き声/獲物/一手/一等/部材/校庭/自販機/大河

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 警報機の鳴き声、誤作動報告、調べろ。
lines.en: Look into the false alarm reports on the warning system.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Sharp attack on the first word. No wasted air. Expects compliance without question. Eyes forward, jaw set.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。獲物となるリスク、社員教育で減らします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll reduce that exposure through staff training.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Level delivery matching the pace of instruction. Slight nod in the voice — acknowledging both the directive and the logic behind it. Professional but not wooden.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の一手、市場拡大、決めるぞ。
lines.en: This quarter's strategy — we're moving on market expansion. That's the call.
lines.style: Decisive, deliberate. Pause before the dash. Weight on 'that's the call' — settles it. Measured but authoritative. The voice of someone who has already decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一等地の物件、賃借更新、交渉中です。
lines.en: We're in active negotiations on the prime-location property lease renewal.
lines.style: Factual, measured. Keeps pace steady. No inflation in the delivery — just the facts as they stand. Slight emphasis on 'active' to show progress is real.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 施設の部材、調達、コスト、見直せ。
lines.en: Facility materials, procurement, costs — all need reviewing. Do it.
lines.style: Clipped, matter-of-fact. Soft staccato on the list. Not harsh, just efficient. Final phrase 'do it' lands without aggression — it's simply the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 校庭近接の事業所、地域連携、深めます。
lines.en: We're deepening our community ties with the school-adjacent sites.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the professional. Slight lift on 'deepening' — this matters beyond the spreadsheet. Measured but genuine. Shows conviction in the approach.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内自販機、地域貢献の取り組みに、活用しろ。
lines.en: Use the internal vending machines as part of our community contribution strategy.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the instruction. Even tone, clear sightline. Not a throwaway detail — there's intention here. Expects buy-in on the bigger picture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。大河ドラマとのタイアップ、企画進めます。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with the Taiga drama partnership.
lines.style: Energetic closing. Slight acceleration on 'moving forward' — momentum is real. Confident, final note. The kind of affirmation that wraps a successful meeting.
